query:
SELECT state_code, state_name, incumbent, incumbent_party,
  dem_candidate, rep_candidate, rating
FROM governor_races
WHERE dem_candidate IS NOT NULL OR rep_candidate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY state_name;
